name: angular
text: Angular (commonly called Angular 2+ or Angular 2) is an open-source web application framework developed on TypeScript, maintained by Google, that is used to create and maintain single-page web applications.

name: angular-library
text: An Angular library is a reusable collection of components, services, directives, and other resources designed to extend Angular's base functionality or solve common problems across multiple applications
Unlike a standard application, a library cannot run on its own and must be imported and used within an existing Angular application

name: angular-material
text: Material Design components for Angular. Internationalized and accessible components for everyone. Well tested to ensure performance and reliability. Straightforward APIs with consistent cross platform behaviour. Provide tools that help developers build their own custom components with common interaction patterns. Customizable within the bounds of the Material Design specification. Built by the Angular team to integrate seamlessly with Angular. Start from scratch or drop into your existing applications.

name: github
text: GitHub is a proprietary developer platform that allows developers to create, store, manage, and share their code. It uses Git to provide distributed version control, and GitHub itself provides access control, bug tracking, software feature requests, task management, continuous integration, and wikis for every project.

name: github-actions
text: GitHub Actions is a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform that allows you to automate your build, test, and deployment pipeline. You can create workflows that build and test every pull request to your repository, or deploy merged pull requests to production. GitHub Actions goes beyond just DevOps and lets you run workflows when other events happen in your repository. For example, you can run a workflow to automatically add the appropriate labels whenever someone creates a new issue in your repository. GitHub provides Linux, Windows, and macOS virtual machines to run your workflows, or you can host your own self-hosted runners in your own data center or cloud infrastructure.

name: tmux
text: Is an open-source terminal multiplexer (ISC license) developed by Nicholas Marriott, designed to allow the creation, access, and control of multiple terminal sessions from a single screen.
It is an essential tool for system administrators and developers, as it allows you to divide the console into panels, manage separate windows, and keep processes running in the background
